issues.display_title: Issue #56: Hire Image Processing: load editors from /v2/photographers/users?role=image_processing
issues.main_description_html:
Description

/hire-image-processing, /image-processing/[slug] and the sitemap still fall back to src/mocks/image-processing.ts.

The data layer asks GET /v1/photographers/users for role=image_processing and keeps only the records whose role matches. v1 list items have no role field, so nothing ever matches and the page always renders the mock. The "top" list calls GET /v1/photographers/users/top, which does not exist.

Backend work this depends on:

  • GoThruMedia/gothru-maps-backend-go#91: role filter and role-scoped equipment on the v2 list
  • GoThruMedia/gothru-maps-backend-go#92: role, timezone and language on the detail endpoint

Requirements

  1. Editors come from GET /v2/photographers/users?role=image_processing, in the backend's ranking order.
  2. The image-processing sitemap pages through that list with the cursor, the same way the photographer sitemap does.
  3. The call to the non-existent /v1/photographers/users/top is removed.
  4. The photographer directory and the photographer sitemap request role=photographer_360, so editors never appear as 360 photographers or twice on the home page.
  5. Software chips and the Software filter read the list's role-scoped equipment.
  6. /image-processing/[slug] keeps using GET /v1/photographers/:slug, which returns role once the detail endpoint change ships.
  7. While the API returns no image_processing records (dev has none today), the pages keep the existing mock fallback.

Acceptance criteria

  • With the backend changes deployed, /hire-image-processing sends no request to /v1/photographers/users or /users/top, and renders live editors whenever any exist.
  • The photographer directory, the home page and the sitemap still list the same 165 photographers.
  • tsc, eslint, npm test and next build pass.

issues.display_title: Issue #58: Hire Image Processing: remove the mock fallback now that the API ships
issues.main_description_html:
Description

/hire-image-processing still shows nine mock editors (Elena Vasquez, Marta Kowalczyk, …), even though it already calls GET /v2/photographers/users?role=image_processing (#56). That endpoint returns 0 records on dev. Whenever the API returns no editors, the data layer falls back to src/mocks/image-processing.ts on purpose, so the page looks exactly as it did before the API existed.

The backend role API has shipped (GoThruMedia/gothru-maps-backend-go#93), so the mock can go. Its own header says so: TODO(integration): delete this file once the backend role/profile API ships.

Requirements

  1. The directory and the home page show only live image_processing users. When there are none, the directory shows its existing "No Image Processing Users Available Yet" state and the home page shows no editor cards.
  2. /image-processing/[slug] renders only live image_processing profiles and returns 404 for anything else, including the former mock slugs.
  3. Reviews come only from the API.
  4. The sitemap lists only live image-processing profiles.
  5. src/mocks/image-processing.ts is deleted. This also removes the placeholder "View Sample" links from #55, which existed only in the mock data.

Acceptance criteria

  • While dev returns 0 editors:
    • /hire-image-processing shows the empty state.
    • /image-processing/aperture-post-lab returns 404.
    • The sitemap has no /image-processing/ URLs.
    • The home page shows no editor cards.
  • The photographer directory, the photographers on the home page and the sitemap stay unchanged (165 photographers).
  • tsc, eslint, npm test and next build pass.
